slides.title: Ready when handed out
slides.html: A phone your MDM sets up reaches its user ready: apps installed, and Deploy App opens under the phone's own callsign.

slides.title: By hand, one phone at a time
slides.html: Without MDM each user opens an invite, waits for an admin to approve them, downloads a key and installs it with a password. Thirty phones, thirty times.

slides.title: With MDM, a whole batch
slides.html: You set it up once. Every phone you enrol gets its apps and the Deploy App icon by itself, and its certificate once you name it. Nobody types an invite code.

slides.title: The key stays on the phone
slides.html: Each phone makes its own key and Deploy App signs it. No key file and no password is passed around.

slides.title: How it works
slides.html: Your MDM sets up the phone. Deploy App gives it an identity: a certificate in its callsign.

slides.title: One callsign per phone
slides.html: Each phone joins as its callsign, such as OTTER4, and reaches Deploy App and its services like any user.

slides.title: Enrol first, name after
slides.html: Phones enrol in any number and any order. Once they all have their apps, name them all at once: each then gets its certificate.

slides.title: You decide when
slides.html: Deploy App issues certificates only while you keep enrolment open, at most 2 hours. Phones can join Fleet at any time. Every opening makes a new challenge: a password your MDM needs.

slides.title: Who does what
slides.html: The Deploy App admin opens enrolment. The MDM operator enrols the phones in Fleet and names them with the connector.

slides.title: What you need
slides.html: Fleet (FleetDM) with Android Enterprise, and a team in it for the phones. Ask your Fleet admin whether Android is turned on in Fleet. The ODMDM connector is optional.

slides.title: One Fleet for each Deploy App
slides.html: With the connector, one Fleet serves one Deploy App. A second Deploy App needs a Fleet of its own.

slides.title: Your route
slides.html: With Fleet and the connector, read Install the connector, Connect your MDM, Enrol phones, Name phones and First start on the phone. The rest is for when you need it.
